lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Hound LooseNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 56THE MERRIPIT NATURALIST: STILL NOT FOUNDThe man who called himself Stapleton is never found. A constable thinks that he has been seen at Plymouth, and a clerk thinks that he has been seen at Southampton, and a magistrate in Hull says that he has seen him in a hat. The wife goes to her relations. The Hall is shut. A year later a farmer on the moor finds the skeleton of a large dog in the heather, and a ring of white wands going out into the Mire. It is the end of a story that was never told, and Dr Mortimer, who has never forgiven you, writes you a polite and puzzled note.The Consulting Detective · 30 choices · Evidence +10, Standing +4, Nerve +1, Hours -1, Hands +5, Wires +4The Case-BookThe Hound of the Baskervilles (the major case, 1889): 1 of 8 endings found.1 of 8 volumes finished.
